CACHE::expire
Description
Forces the document to be revalidated from the server.
Syntax
CACHE
::
expire
CACHE::expire
Forces the document to be revalidated from the server.
Examples
when
CACHE_RESPONSE
{
if
{
$expired
equals
1
}
{
CACHE
::
expire
log
"cache expire"
}
}
